diagnostic_steps.name: Step-1-Reconstruct
diagnostic_steps.purpose: Full Dirichlet constraint on DOFs 1 and 3 on all 16,642 nodes, and DOF 2 on all non-N_TOP nodes. N_TOP vertical displacement is governed identically by *EQUATION coupling to N_RP at 0.0050 mm without constraint conflict.

diagnostic_steps.name: Step-2-Hold
diagnostic_steps.purpose: Unconstrained release of interior DOFs 1, 2 and phase-field DOF 3 (OP=NEW) with constant displacement hold
prescribed_dofs: Physical BCs: N_BOTTOM (uy=0), N_PIN (ux=0), N_TOP (ux=0), N_RP (uy=0.0050)
released_dofs: All interior mechanical DOFs 1, 2 and phase-field DOF 3
diagnostic_steps.time_stepping: 0.05, 1.0, 1.0e-6, 0.10 (up to 20 increments, allowing observation of first release increments)

gate_c1_equilibrium_residual_norm.name: Gate C1: Equilibrium Residual Norm at Release
gate_c1_equilibrium_residual_norm.notes: Physical measurement requires Abaqus solver execution to extract largest residual force norm (R_max / q_tilde) at Step 2 Increment 1 from .msg.

gate_c2_reaction_force_parity.name: Gate C2: Reaction Force Parity Across Step Boundary
gate_c2_reaction_force_parity.notes: Physical measurement requires comparing recipient RF_2 at Step 2 Increment 1 against donor reference 653.0886 N.

gate_c3_total_internal_energy_continuity.name: Gate C3: Total Internal Energy Continuity Across Step Boundary
gate_c3_total_internal_energy_continuity.notes: Physical measurement requires comparing UEL internal energy at Step 2 Increment 1 (from uel_energy_balance.csv) against donor reference 1.663384 mJ.

gate_c4_pointwise_damage_irreversibility.name: Gate C4: Pointwise Damage Irreversibility
gate_c4_pointwise_damage_irreversibility.criterion: min(Delta d) >= -1.0e-4 across all 16,642 physical nodes
gate_c4_pointwise_damage_irreversibility.notes: Physical measurement requires comparing post-release nodal damage d at Increment 1 of Step-2-Hold against transferred d across all 16,642 physical nodes.

gate_c5_artificial_crack_tip_damage_cap.name: Gate C5: Artificial Crack-Tip Damage Increase Cap
gate_c5_artificial_crack_tip_damage_cap.notes: Physical measurement requires tracking coordinate-resolved crack-tip Node 209 (and cluster nodes) damage evolution during unconstrained release increments.
